changelog: - **`/admin/offers`: a search no longer drops the preset it was typed into** (#2161). Two races, one screen. `setParams` built the next URL from the render-time `useSearchParams()` snapshot it closed over, and `router.replace()` does not synchronously re-render — so a preset click followed by a search submit in the same tick merged `q` onto the **pre-preset** params, silently dropping the preset's `status` and listing offers from outside the view the admin was looking at. It now writes through a ref that is authoritative the instant a navigation is issued (and is re-synced from the URL for a back button or a link). Second, the search box was React state that other handlers reset imperatively — both `applyPreset` and the clear button called `setSearch('')` — so a keystroke arriving between the click and React flushing that reset was wiped and the form submitted an empty query. The field is now uncontrolled and keyed by the URL's own `q`: the DOM owns the text, and it is re-mounted only when the URL changes, which is the only time anything but the user should change it. The product question the issue left open is answered in the code: a preset names a **view**, the search box narrows **within** it, and choosing a preset clears the query — composing in that one direction, because replacing the preset from the search box would leave no way to search inside a preset at all. `e2e/admin-offers.spec.ts` is 5/5.

en: On the offers screen, searching while a quick filter is active now searches inside that filter instead of quietly dropping it and showing offers from outside it.
Typing into the search box immediately after picking a filter no longer loses what you typed.
tr: Teklifler ekranında bir hızlı filtre açıkken arama yapmak artık filtreyi sessizce düşürüp dışındaki teklifleri göstermiyor; aramayı o filtrenin içinde yapıyor.
Filtreyi seçer seçmez arama kutusuna yazdığınızda yazdığınız artık kaybolmuyor.
de: Eine Suche bei aktivem Schnellfilter sucht jetzt innerhalb dieses Filters, statt ihn stillschweigend zu verwerfen und Angebote von außerhalb anzuzeigen.
Wer direkt nach dem Wählen eines Filters ins Suchfeld tippt, verliert das Getippte nicht mehr.
